description: Create Supabase database schema for tasks, connected apps, and OAuth tokens with TypeScript types and service layer. Establishes the data foundation for all subsequent integrations.

userStories.title: Create Supabase Local Development Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Supabase CLI configured locally so that I can create and test database migrations before deploying.
acceptanceCriteria: Supabase CLI installed globally (npm install -g supabase)
supabase/ folder created at project root
supabase init run to create config structure
supabase/migrations/ folder exists for SQL migrations
supabase/config.toml configured with project settings
.gitignore updated to exclude supabase/.temp/ if present
README section added to supabase/ explaining migration workflow
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Foundation for all database work. Installed via Homebrew (npm global not supported).

userStories.title: Create Database Enums
userStories.description: As a developer, I need PostgreSQL enums defined so that columns have constrained, type-safe values.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration file created: supabase/migrations/20260111000001_create_enums.sql
integration_provider enum: google, notion, slack, linear, jira
connection_status enum: active, token_expired, refresh_failed, revoked, disconnected
task_source enum: notion, email, slack, ai_suggestion, manual
task_priority enum: high, medium, low
task_status enum: pending, approved, dismissed, snoozed
Migration can be applied without errors
Enums visible in Supabase dashboard under Database → Types
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Must be created before tables that use these enums. Enums provide type safety at database level.

userStories.title: Create connected_apps Table
userStories.description: As a system, I need to track which OAuth integrations each user has connected so that I know which services to sync.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration file created: supabase/migrations/20260111000002_create_connected_apps.sql

Table connected_apps created with columns: id, user_id, provider, status, provider_account_id, provider_account_name, provider_account_email, granted_scopes, connected_at, last_sync_at, created_at, updated_at
Primary key: id (UUID, auto-generated)
Foreign key: user_id references auth.users(id) with ON DELETE CASCADE
Unique constraint on (user_id, provider)
Trigger created for auto-updating updated_at on row changes
RLS enabled on table
RLS policy: users can SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only their own rows
Migration applied successfully
Table visible in Supabase dashboard
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Tracks integrations like Google, Notion, Slack. Each user can have one connection per provider. Migration created with all RLS policies and auto-update trigger.

userStories.title: Create oauth_tokens Table (Server-Side Only)
userStories.description: As a system, I need to securely store OAuth tokens so that Edge Functions can make API calls on behalf of users.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration file created: supabase/migrations/20260111000003_create_oauth_tokens.sql
Table oauth_tokens created with columns: id, connected_app_id, access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_at, created_at, updated_at
Primary key: id (UUID, auto-generated)
Foreign key: connected_app_id references connected_apps(id) with ON DELETE CASCADE
Index created on connected_app_id for fast lookups
RLS enabled on table
NO RLS policies created - table inaccessible from client
Comment added explaining server-side-only access pattern
Migration applied successfully
Verify: SELECT * FROM oauth_tokens from client returns empty/error
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: CRITICAL SECURITY: No RLS policies = no client access. Only Edge Functions with service_role key can read/write. Migration created with cascading foreign key to connected_apps, index for fast lookups, and reuses update_updated_at_column() trigger.

userStories.title: Create tasks Table
userStories.description: As a user, I need my tasks stored in the database so that swipe actions persist and I see the same tasks across devices.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration file created: supabase/migrations/20260111000004_create_tasks.sql
Table tasks created with typed columns: id, user_id, source, source_id, title, description, category, priority_level, status, due_date
JSONB metadata column for source-specific data
Lifecycle columns: snoozed_until, actioned_at, deleted_at (soft delete)
Timestamp columns: created_at, updated_at with auto-update trigger
Foreign key: user_id references auth.users(id) with ON DELETE CASCADE
Index on (user_id, status) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL for feed queries
Index on (user_id, source, source_id) for deduplication
RLS enabled with policy: users can only access their own tasks
Migration applied successfully
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Core table for the app. Uses hybrid pattern: typed columns for common fields, JSONB for source-specific metadata. Reuses update_updated_at_column() trigger function. Partial index excludes soft-deleted tasks for efficient feed queries.

userStories.title: Apply Migrations to Supabase
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the migrations applied to the remote Supabase project so that the tables exist in production.
acceptanceCriteria: All migration files reviewed for correctness
Migrations applied to Supabase via dashboard SQL editor OR supabase db push
All 5 enums visible in Database → Types
All 3 tables visible in Database → Tables: connected_apps, oauth_tokens, tasks
RLS enabled indicator shows on all 3 tables
Test: SELECT * FROM tasks returns empty result (not error)
Test: Insert and select own task as authenticated user works
Test: SELECT * FROM oauth_tokens from client returns empty (RLS blocks)
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: User applied migrations via Supabase dashboard SQL editor.

userStories.title: Generate TypeScript Types from Schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need TypeScript types generated from the database schema so that I have compile-time type safety for all queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Supabase CLI linked to project: supabase link --project-ref <project-id>
Types generated: supabase gen types typescript --linked > types/database.ts
types/database.ts file created with all table types
Each table has Row, Insert, and Update type variants
Enum types are generated as TypeScript string literal unions
services/supabase.ts updated to import and use Database type
Supabase client is typed: createClient<Database>(...)
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Types generated via supabase gen types. Supabase client now fully typed. types/task.ts updated to use generated types.

userStories.title: Create Task TypeScript Interface with Metadata Types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Task interface that extends the database types with source-specific metadata for type-safe handling in components.
acceptanceCriteria: types/task.ts file created
TaskRow, TaskInsert, TaskUpdate types exported from database types
TaskSource, TaskStatus, TaskPriority enum types exported
NotionTaskMetadata interface: page_id, database_id, properties, url
EmailTaskMetadata interface: message_id, thread_id, from, to, subject, snippet
SlackTaskMetadata interface: channel_id, channel_name, message_ts, thread_ts, sender_id
TaskMetadata union type combining all metadata interfaces
Task interface extending TaskRow with typed metadata
TaskCard.tsx updated to import Task from types/task.ts
No functionality changes to TaskCard - just import path update
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Created types/database.ts with manual types matching schema and types/task.ts with source-specific metadata types. Added CardTask for UI compatibility with priority display conversion. TaskCard.tsx now imports from types/task.ts.

userStories.title: Create Task Service Layer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service layer that encapsulates all task database operations so that components don't directly call Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: services/tasks/ folder created
services/tasks/task-service.ts file created
TaskServiceResult<T> type with data and error fields
FetchTasksOptions interface with status, source, limit
fetchUserTasks(userId, options?) function implemented
updateTaskStatus(taskId, status) function implemented
snoozeTask(taskId, until) function implemented
createTask(task) function implemented
All functions return TaskServiceResult with proper typing
Console logging added for debugging
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Service layer encapsulates all task CRUD operations. Uses untyped Supabase client until US-007 generates proper types.

userStories.title: Connect Feed to Database with Sample Fallback
userStories.description: As a user, I want my feed to show real tasks from the database, with sample tasks as fallback when the database is empty.
acceptanceCriteria: app/(tabs)/index.tsx imports fetchUserTasks and updateTaskStatus from task service
useAuth hook used to get current user ID
useEffect fetches tasks on mount when user is available
Loading state shown while fetching (ActivityIndicator or skeleton)
If tasks returned from database: display database tasks
If no tasks (empty array): display SAMPLE_TASKS as fallback
If fetch error: show error message with option to use sample data
handleApprove calls updateTaskStatus(taskId, 'approved')
handleDismiss calls updateTaskStatus(taskId, 'dismissed')
Console logs confirm database updates
Verify on device: App loads and shows tasks or sample fallback
Typecheck passes: npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Feed connected to task service with loading, error, and sample fallback states. Swipe actions update task status in database. Device verification pending US-006 (migrations).
